changelog: Interactive high-definition multi-tile GTA V map engine for civilian & admin tablet (/meteo_tablet).
Point inspection popover with real-time weather, temperature, humidity, and storm intersection.
Comprehensive storm spawn probability scheduler with configurable global and per-type rates.
Added Sandstorm and Toxic storm categories with severity scaling (moderate to cataclysmic).
Direct click-to-spawn modal on Doppler radar map and instant random storm generator.
